summary: Iteration 20 — P0 worker-scaling fix on multi-slot businesses AND 1:1 real-time German clock are both fully working. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_scaling_clock.py (worker-scaling doubling on bistro, 1-slot cap on kiosk with 400 'Shift overlaps with ...', kiosk split-shift single-worker-equivalent net, market kiosk L1 profit_day estimate, German time_scale=1.0 + Berlin wall-clock alignment). Direct engine verification on a live-created bistro (opening 10:00–22:00, base_slots=2): ONE worker on full opening -> worker_hours=12, capacity_day=35.7, rev_day=$1357.92, net_day=$530.40. TWO CONCURRENT workers on full opening -> worker_hours=24 (2.00x), capacity_day=71.5 (2.00x), rev_day=$2715.84 (2.00x), net_day=$1107.36 (2.09x). Ratios are 1.98–2.00 across worker_hours/capacity_day/rev_day. Kiosk (1-slot) rejects overlapping shifts with HTTP 400 'Shift overlaps with <name> — only 1 worker(s) can be active at the same time.' Split-shift kiosk (08–14 + 14–20) net_day ≈ single-worker equivalent (~$205, well within ±20% of the $220 spec target). Economy regression `python3 /app/tests/verify_economy.py` prints ALL TESTS PASSED (10/10 tests incl. Worker-scaling test PASSED: 1 worker -> 120.0 units, 2 concurrent workers -> 240.0 units (2x), and 1-slot cap test PASSED: 2 overlapping workers on 1 slot -> 12.0 worker-hours (not doubled)). GET /api/businesses/market kiosk estimate.profit_day = $219.83 (target $220, 0.08% off, within ±3%). GET /api/game/state returns time_scale=1.0 and game_time hh:mm aligned to Europe/Berlin wall clock within a few seconds. Frontend dashboard header renders 'REAL-TIME 15:18' matching current CEST wall time (15:12 six minutes earlier), REAL-TIME green pill visible, all sidebar/UI strings English (Dashboard, Home & Needs, Skills, Social, Messages, Daily Summary, Job Center, Current Job, Player Jobs, Education, Shop, Bank & Loans, Real Estate, Vehicle Dealer, Buy a Business, My Businesses, Underworld, Police Record, Hospital, Jail, Leaderboard, Effectiveness, Standing in the City, Reputation, Legal Standing, Criminal Suspicion, Social Status), zero German UI strings detected. Metrics endpoint returns concurrent_slots (2 for bistro, 1 for kiosk) as required; active/staff counts drive the 'Working now' status per role.

minor.issue: capacity_day/rev_day/net_day/sold_day are stored fields updated only after resolve_business runs at the next game tick. With time_scale=1.0 (1:1 real time), a freshly-hired-into business shows rev_day=0 in the response until a tick actually resolves it (which can take real minutes). worker_hours is not exposed in the API surface at all (only covered_hours and concurrent_slots are). This is not a bug per se, but the API caller cannot observe the doubling immediately; only via forecast/estimate or by waiting for a tick. Consider exposing worker_hours in metrics and/or computing rev_day forecast inline (like the market estimate) for immediate feedback.

issues: DAY counter shows 'DAY -8584' — clock hh:mm is correctly aligned to Berlin wall time (15:18 vs 15:12 six minutes prior), but the day index is negative. Backend game_engine.game_day_index = int((game_now - world_start_game).days) — since world_start_game was hard-set to a very recent timestamp (~now+2h) in migrate_business_supply_chain, day should be 0 or 1 for a fresh install. -8584 suggests the migration/reset either ran off a much later world_start_game or the frontend derives 'day' from a different anchor (e.g., in-game calendar year). Not a P0 (review only asks that DAY be 'sensible'), but the negative sign is user-facing and confusing — worth verifying in a follow-up.

action_items: (P3, non-blocking) Investigate 'DAY -8584' shown on Dashboard header. Clock hh:mm is correct but day index is a large negative number — likely a mismatch between the frontend's day-derivation anchor and the world_start_game reset applied during migrate_business_supply_chain. Verify game_engine.game_day_index vs frontend day rendering.

(P3, DX) Consider exposing 'worker_hours' and a forecast 'rev_day'/'capacity_day' in GET /api/businesses/{id}/employees.metrics so UI can display projected doubling immediately without waiting for a real-time tick.
critical_code_review_comments: employee_engine.py:244 calculate_effective_worker_hours = employment.effective_worker_hours_per_day(opening, [e['schedule'] for e in workers], slots) — this is the P0 fix, correctly implemented: production drives on sum over opening of min(concurrent, slots), so 2 workers on a 2-slot business over the whole opening = 2 × opening_hours, and capacity/rev/net all scale 2x with satisfaction/level multipliers held constant. Verified live: worker_hours 12→24, capacity 35.7→71.5, rev $1358→$2716 on bistro L1.

server.py:1660 set_employee_shift correctly enforces peak_concurrent <= concurrent_slots (= sum(reqs.recommended) + level-1). For kiosk (concurrent_slots=1) any overlap returns 400 with English 'Shift overlaps with <name> — only 1 worker(s) can be active at the same time. Upgrade to add a slot, or pick non-overlapping hours.' — exact spec match.

server.py:2805-2819 migrate_business_supply_chain hard-syncs the world clock to Europe/Berlin at time_scale=1.0 via a one-time time_synced_de flag, computing world_start_game = now_utc + Berlin_offset so game_now(cfg)=UTC-naive Berlin wall time. Live GET /api/game/state confirms alignment within seconds. Idempotent via time_synced_de flag.

employee_engine.py business_metrics response includes 'concurrent_slots' (max_slots = base_slots + level-1) — the UI and API tests correctly use this to determine multi-slot vs 1-slot behavior. Not exposed: 'worker_hours' (only covered_hours) — see minor issue in report.

employment.effective_worker_hours_per_day + concurrency_segments are the canonical building blocks and produce the same numbers as the direct-engine and verify_economy.py tests; single source of truth for scaling.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 pytest: German clock 1/1, kiosk market estimate 1/1, 1-slot overlap 400 1/1, kiosk split-shift ~$220 1/1, bistro worker-scaling 2x 1/1) + 10/10 verify_economy.py
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Dashboard clock aligned to Berlin, REAL-TIME pill visible, English UI throughout sidebar/status/quick-access, no German strings)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `cd /app/backend && MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python -m pytest tests/test_iteration20_scaling_clock.py -v --tb=short -o addopts='' -p no:cacheprovider --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration20.xml`. Key gotchas discovered: (1) bistro/auto_repair/delivery_service/online_shop have skill-based requirements (technology/cooking/etc.) via meets_requirements — a raw fresh character CANNOT buy them; admin PUT /api/admin/players/{id} accepts a `skills` dict that sets skill level directly. (2) GET /api/businesses/{id}/employees returns metrics with 'concurrent_slots' but NOT 'worker_hours'. (3) Freshly-hired businesses show rev_day=0 in the metrics until resolve_business runs at the next game tick (which is 1:1 real time now); to observe the doubling immediately, import employee_engine + employment and call employee_engine._day_rates(b, workers, slots=slots) directly against the DB — this bypasses the tick and yields authoritative forecast values. (4) kiosk overlap error string contains the substring 'overlap' (English). (5) Live proof of P0: bistro L1 workers=1 -> {worker_hours:12, capacity:35.7, rev_day:1357.92, net_day:530.4}; workers=2 concurrent -> {worker_hours:24, capacity:71.5, rev_day:2715.84, net_day:1107.36}. Ratios ≈2.00x across the board.
rca of the issue: N/A — P0 already fixed in this iteration. Fix is in employee_engine.calculate_effective_worker_hours (delegates to employment.effective_worker_hours_per_day summing min(concurrent, slots) over opening) which correctly gives 2x worker-hours -> 2x capacity_day -> 2x rev_day/net_day on a 2-slot business with two concurrent workers. Real-time German clock fix is in server.py migrate_business_supply_chain (one-time reset of world_start_real=now_utc, world_start_game=now_utc+Berlin_offset, time_scale=1.0, guarded by time_synced_de flag) — this makes game_now(cfg) = UTC-naive Berlin wall time. Both verified end-to-end.
